rationale: Every D001-D062 dependency and C01-C12 semantic check was reviewed in order against Proposition 2.7.1(d), Definition 2.7.5, and display (2.21). PsiOneGauge unfolds to the exact sInf appearing on the right. PsiOneAdmissible represents t>0 by finite nonzero ENNReal, for which toReal and division are exact, and it makes explicit the measurability and integrability already implicit in a real random variable with finite exponential expectation. The source's sub-exponential context guarantees a nonempty finite-scale set; ENNReal's empty-set/top convention only totalizes cases outside that context. The arbitrary-measure universal binder likewise conservatively extends the definition and does not change its restriction to source probability spaces. Both implication directions therefore hold. The only source issue is the prose's K3/property-3 typo, while the numbered display and Lean statement agree on the one-point threshold-2 formula.
